patterns.name: context_as_parent
patterns.rule: Use curated context to shape structure and decisions before changing output artifacts.

patterns.name: corpus_before_confidence
patterns.rule: A stale or weak corpus should produce explicit uncertainty and next-evidence requests, not confident invention.

patterns.name: foldered_prompt_discipline
patterns.rule: Separate specs, plans, prompts, and reminders so generation instructions reflect stable product truth instead of one-off improvisation.

patterns.name: embedding_ready_sources
patterns.rule: Organize reusable runtime knowledge as machine-readable JSON so it can later be indexed, chunked, and embedded without re-authoring the source.
